reference_sql:
WITH product_revenue AS (  -- one row per TV & Video product with sales in January to June 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id, product_name
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product, with its place in its category and the category's total
  SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, revenue_eur,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC) AS revenue_rank,
         SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS category_revenue_eur
  FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue_eur / category_revenue_eur, 1) AS category_share_pct,
       revenue_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category_name, revenue_rank, product_id

WITH product_revenue AS (  -- one row per TV & Video product with sales in January to June 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id, product_name
),
category_totals AS (  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_name, SUM(revenue_eur) AS category_revenue_eur
  FROM product_revenue
  GROUP BY category_name
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product, with its place in its category
  SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, revenue_eur,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT r.category_name, r.product_id, r.product_name, r.revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * r.revenue_eur / t.category_revenue_eur, 1) AS category_share_pct,
       r.revenue_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN category_totals t ON t.category_name = r.category_name
WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY 1, 6, 2

WITH product_revenue AS (  -- one row per TV & Video product with sales in January to June 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video'
    AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
placed AS (  -- one row per product: its place is one more than the number of its category's products with more revenue
  SELECT p.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.revenue_eur,
         ROUND(100.0 * p.revenue_eur / (SELECT SUM(q.revenue_eur) FROM product_revenue q WHERE q.category_name = p.category_name), 1) AS category_share_pct,
         1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_revenue q WHERE q.category_name = p.category_name AND q.revenue_eur > p.revenue_eur) AS revenue_rank
  FROM product_revenue p
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, revenue_eur, category_share_pct, revenue_rank
FROM placed
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category_name ASC, revenue_rank ASC, product_id ASC
